subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every month, the school counselor placed a blue envelope in each classroom.”?
options: Students could write questions on paper and put them inside.
Now students write many kinds of messages.
Some students wanted to write long messages.
Students could write worries and put them inside.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students could write questions on paper and put them inside.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Now students write many kinds of messages.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Some students wanted to write long messages.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students could write worries and put them inside.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students could write worries and put them inside.」，答案為「Students could write worries and put them inside.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students could write worries and put them inside.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
